model.name: RbFileDetail.renderWithBrowseLink
model.description: Render file detail: (1) fetch /api/trace/children/<fileUuid> for metadata. (2) Header: File type + name + mimeType + size. (3) ContentPreviewer: renderContentPreview(uuid, mimeType, name, token) for inline preview. (4) Browse link: /md/{scenarioPath}/?highlight={uuid}.scenario.json (file browser with file highlighted, uses scenarioBrowserLinkFromIor). (5) Edit link: /edit/{scenarioPath}/{uuid}.scenario.json (Monaco editor on scenario unit). (6) Source link: if model.sourceFile, link to /edit/{sourceFile}#L{line}.
